items.title: Submit payslips for February–April 2027
items.quote: Reichen Sie uns bitte bis 14.05.2027 Ihre Lohnabrechnungen für Februar bis April 2027 ein.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date: bis 14.05.2027. 14 May 2027 is a Friday, a normal working day, so no weekend/holiday adjustment is needed. The due date is used as written.

items.title: File Widerspruch against the provisional benefit decision
items.quote: Dieser Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, mit dem Widerspruch angefochten werden.
items.computation: The Jobcenter is a social-law body (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies, like other social-law authorities), so the deemed-delivery day of a posted letter is the 4th calendar day after posting and does NOT move even if it falls on a weekend or holiday. The letter is dated 23.04.2027 (Friday) with no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date, so posting day = 23.04.2027. 4th day after: 24, 25, 26, 27 April → delivered 27.04.2027 (Tuesday). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG / § 26 SGB X with §§ 187, 188 BGB) starts the next day and ends on the day with the same number one month later: 27.05.2027 (Thursday), which is a normal working day in Bayern, so the deadline does not shift further. Final deadline: 27.05.2027.
